This file is for doing data import.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Import our first dataset.

```{r}
litters_df =
  read_csv("data/FAS_litters.csv", lazy = FALSE)

litters_df = janitor::clean_names(litters_df)
```

Import your second dataset.

```{r}
pups_df = 
  read_csv("data/FAS_pups.cvs", skip = 3, lazy = FALSE)

pups_df = janitor::clean_names(pups_df)
```

## Look at the data

```{r}
litters_df
pups_df
```

Head or tail

```{r}
head(litters_df, 20)

tail(pups_df, 5)
```
